name: Proposal or Opportunity Intake
description: Capture the client situation, opportunity, win strategy, and proposal work required.

sections.title: Client Situation and Opportunity
sections.instruction: Summarize the client context, opportunity, desired outcomes, and known scope.

sections.title: Stakeholders and Timing
sections.instruction: List stakeholders, decision roles, dates, and commercial statements that were actually discussed.

sections.title: Win Themes and Differentiators
sections.instruction: Capture proposed win themes, competitive context, and differentiators as hypotheses unless confirmed.

sections.title: Solution and Proof Needs
sections.instruction: List solution ideas, relevant proof points, references, demos, or credentials needed.

sections.title: Gaps and Risks
sections.instruction: List missing inputs, qualification questions, dependencies, and risks.

sections.title: Actions
sections.instruction: List proposal actions with owners and dates when stated.
